prompt: Design a replacement mounting bracket for an e-bike wheel speed sensor. It should attach securely to a bicycle chain stay, keep the sensor aligned with the wheel spokes, and allow attachment using a screw and zip tie. Keep the design compact and practical. For this specification, target one solid output with an overall envelope of approximately 14.0 mm x 13.7 mm x 26.5 mm.
